Ten collocations

Say the phrase, then the sentence. Cover the collocations and tap a row to check your memory.

  • partdeep side part

    Let's do a deep side part on the left.

  • bangsside-swept bangs

    I will blow-dry your side-swept bangs first.

  • wavesloose waves

    I use a curling iron to make loose waves.

  • curlsbouncy curls

    Do you want bouncy curls or soft waves?

  • updoformal updo

    A formal updo is perfect for the red carpet.

  • bunlow bun

    I put the low bun at the back of your neck.

  • braidfishtail braid

    A fishtail braid will stay in the wind.

  • sleeksleek finish

    I use the flat iron for a sleek finish.

  • volumeadd volume

    I use mousse to add volume to your hair.

  • textureadd texture

    This spray will add texture to your hair.

Page 3 of 4

Five dialogs

Work in pairs. The student plays the stylist and the teacher plays the client. Hide the stylist lines to answer from memory, and gap the phrases to recall the collocations. Tap the speaker next to a word to hear it.

Red carpet

Words to learn
  • red carpetкрасная дорожка
  • tightтугой, тугая
  • suggestпредлагать, советовать
  • elegantэлегантный
StylistGood afternoon. What is the event tonight?
ClientA red carpet event. I want a formal updo.
StylistBeautiful. Do you want a high bun or a low bun?
ClientA low bun, please. But not too tight.
StylistNo problem. I will add texture with a spray, so it looks soft.
ClientGood. What about the part?
StylistI suggest a deep side part. It looks elegant with your dress.
ClientPerfect. Let's start.

Yacht party

Words to learn
  • yachtяхта
  • windyветреный
  • looseсвободный, нетугой
  • pull outвытянуть, выпустить
  • flatплоский, без объёма
  • blow-dryсушить феном, укладывать феном
ClientI have a party on a yacht tonight. It will be windy.
StylistThen I suggest a fishtail braid. It stays in the wind.
ClientCan it be loose? I don't like tight braids.
StylistOf course. I will pull out a few pieces to add texture.
ClientMy hair is flat today, too.
StylistNo problem. I will blow-dry it first to add volume.
ClientGreat, thank you.

Photoshoot

Words to learn
  • flat ironутюжок для волос
  • frizzпушистые, непослушные волоски
  • serumсыворотка
  • hairsprayлак для волос
StylistHow much time do we have?
ClientThirty minutes. I need a sleek finish for the photos.
StylistOK. First I blow-dry your hair, then I use the flat iron.
ClientCan you add volume at the top? I hate flat hair.
StylistSure. A deep side part also gives more volume.
ClientGood idea. And no frizz, please.
StylistNo frizz. I will use serum and finish with hairspray.

Hotel dinner

Words to learn
  • softмягкий
  • curling ironплойка, щипцы для завивки
ClientI want something soft for dinner tonight.
StylistI can do loose waves, or bouncy curls like in this photo.
ClientBouncy curls look fun, but not too tight.
StylistDon't worry. I will use a big curling iron. What about your bangs?
ClientThey are long now. Can you do side-swept bangs?
StylistYes. I will blow-dry them away from your face.
ClientPerfect. Thank you.

Last practice

Wedding guest, open-back dress

Words to learn
  • backlessс открытой спиной
  • show offпоказать, подчеркнуть
  • twistскрутка, жгут
  • slicked backгладко зачёсанный назад
  • texturedс текстурой
  • face-framingобрамляющий лицо
  • naturalестественный
  • pinsшпильки
StylistWhat are we creating today? Do you have photos, or just ideas?
ClientI have a photo. And a backless dress for tonight. Something pretty, but not too formal.
StylistMay I see the photo? Oh, I love this one. An updo will show off the back. What do you like most about it?
ClientI like the shape, but it is too high for me. Can it be lower?
StylistOf course. A low bun, or a twist?
ClientA low bun, but loose, not slicked back.
StylistGot it. In the photo, a few pieces fall around the face. Do you want those too?
ClientYes, but softer. Maybe loose waves around my face.
StylistLovely. Do you want me to add volume at the top?
ClientA little, please. But not too much.
StylistPerfect. Let me check: a soft, textured low bun, a deep side part, and a few face-framing waves. Sound right?
ClientYes, exactly. I just want it to look natural.
StylistThen I will add texture with a light spray and use pins to hold it. It will stay all night.
ClientWonderful. I want to dance, and I don't want to think about my hair!
StylistYou won't. Let's start.
